verdict.rationale: Airbyte publishes a full REST API for programmatically creating/configuring sources, destinations, connections, and syncing (airbyte-docs-3/17/18/46), which covers most core UI actions, and also offers Terraform and PyAirbyte for config-as-code. However, some UI-only features like the no-code Connector Builder and its AI Assistant are documented as part of the Airbyte UI with no clear API equivalent, and a probe for a public OpenAPI spec at the docs site returned 404s (airbyte-probe-2), suggesting API discoverability/parity isn't fully confirmed. missing for 10: explicit documentation that Connector Builder/AI Assist functions are also exposed via API, a working public OpenAPI/swagger spec, and independent confirmation of full UI-API feature parity.
